docs.name: aase_syndrome
symptoms: Narrow shoulders ,  Droopy eyelids ,  Absent or small knuckles ,  Deformed ears ,  Pale skin ,  Triple-jointed thumbs ,  Cleft palate ,  Inability to fully extend the joints from birth
docs.description: I've been aware of some unusual physical characteristics that have been concerning me, including my narrow shoulders, droopy eyelids, and absent or small knuckles. Additionally, my ears are deformed, and my skin is quite pale. I've also noticed that I have triple-jointed thumbs, which is quite unusual. Furthermore, I was born with a cleft palate, and I've struggled with an inability to fully extend my joints since birth.

docs.name: bulimia
symptoms: Excessive exercise ,  Forcing oneself to vomit ,  Throwing away packages of laxatives, diet pills, emetics (drugs that cause vomiting), or diuretics ,  Spending a lot of time exercising ,  Suddenly eating large amounts of food or buying large amounts of food that disappear right away ,  Using laxatives, enemas, or diuretics (water pills) ,  Regularly going to the bathroom right after meals
docs.description: I've been struggling with some concerning habits lately, including excessive exercise and forcing myself to vomit, which has led me to throw away packages of laxatives, diet pills, emetics, or diuretics. I've also been spending an inordinate amount of time exercising, and I've noticed that I've been suddenly eating large amounts of food or buying large quantities that seem to disappear quickly. Furthermore, I've been relying on laxatives, enemas, or diuretics, and I've developed a habit of regularly going to the bathroom right after meals, which is causing me a lot of distress.

docs.name: carcinoid_syndrome
symptoms: Diarrhea ,  Difficulty breathing, such as wheezing ,  Heart problems, such as leaking heart valves, slow heartbeat, low or high blood pressure ,  Flushing (face, neck, or upper chest), or widened blood vessels seen on the skin (telangiectasias)
docs.description: I've been experiencing some distressing symptoms lately, including persistent diarrhea and difficulty breathing, which is often accompanied by wheezing. Additionally, I've been concerned about potential heart problems, such as leaking heart valves, a slow heartbeat, or abnormal blood pressure, which could be high or low. Furthermore, I've noticed some unusual physical changes, including flushing on my face, neck, or upper chest, as well as widened blood vessels visible on my skin, known as telangiectasias.

docs.name: cushing_syndrome
symptoms: Increased thirst and urination ,  Purple stretch marks (1/2 inch or 1 centimeter or more wide) called striae on the skin of the abdomen, upper arms, thighs, and breasts ,  High blood pressure (hypertension) ,  Thin skin with easy bruising (especially on the arms and hands) ,  Headache ,  Backache, which occurs with routine activities ,  Excess hair growth on the face, neck, chest, abdomen, and thighs ,  Mental changes, such as depression, anxiety, or changes in behavior ,  Weak muscles, especially of the hips and shoulders ,  Type 2 diabetes mellitus ,  Round, red, full face (moon face) ,  Periods that become irregular or stop ,  Rib and spine fractures caused by thinning of the bones ,  Slow growth rate (in children) ,  Bone pain or tenderness ,  Increased cholesterol and triglycerides (hyperlipidemia) ,  Erection problems ,  Skin infections ,  Weight gain with fat accumulation on the trunk, but fat loss from the arms, legs, and buttocks (central obesity) ,  Fatigue ,  Decreased or no desire for sex (low libido) ,  Collection of fat between the shoulders and above collar bones
docs.description: I've been experiencing a multitude of symptoms lately, including increased thirst and urination, which has been quite bothersome. I've also noticed the appearance of purple stretch marks, called striae, on my abdomen, upper arms, thighs, and breasts, which are quite wide, about 1/2 inch or 1 centimeter or more. Additionally, I've been dealing with high blood pressure, and my skin has become thin and prone to easy bruising, especially on my arms and hands. I've been having frequent headaches and backaches, even with routine activities, and I've noticed excess hair growth on my face, neck, chest, abdomen, and thighs. I've also been experiencing mental changes, such as depression, anxiety, and changes in behavior. Furthermore, I've been struggling with weak muscles, especially in my hips and shoulders, and I've been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes mellitus. My face has taken on a round, red, full appearance, and my periods have become irregular or stopped. I've also experienced rib and spine fractures due to thinning of the bones, and I've been experiencing bone pain or tenderness. My growth rate has slowed down, and I've had increased cholesterol and triglycerides. I've also been dealing with erection problems, skin infections, and weight gain with fat accumulation on my trunk, but fat loss from my arms, legs, and buttocks. On top of all this, I've been feeling fatigued, and my desire for sex has decreased significantly. Lastly, I've noticed a collection of fat between my shoulders and above my collar bones.
